cargo.reason: No patched release exists. The Marvin timing attack needs an attacker who can observe many decryption timings, such as over a network. RSA decryption runs client-side only, and decrypt_blinded reduces (but does not remove) the leak. Recheck when rsa 0.10 is stable.
